questions.question: Explain how to filter data based on text, numbers and dates.
questions.solution_html:
• Explanation (6 Marks)
  • Filtering allows users to display only specific data that meet certain
  • conditions.
  • Text Filter: Filters data based on text conditions such as begins
  • with, ends with, or contains.
  • Number Filter: Filters numbers using conditions like greater
  • than, less than, equal to, or between.
  • Date Filter: Filters data based on dates such as today, yesterday
  • this month, or specific date ranges.
  • This helps in analyzing large datasets efficiently.
questions.final_answer: This helps in analyzing large datasets efficiently
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
